title_ja: 当社の業務委託先における個人情報漏えいのおそれについて
title_en: Possible leak of personal information at our outsourcing contractor
summary_en: Taiju Life Insurance announced on 20 September 2024 that its outsourced document storage and delivery contractor, Sougyo Service, was hit by a ransomware attack on 12 September. Taiju Life was told of this on 18 September, and a later report said personal data may have leaked. The data at risk is the names, addresses and phone numbers of up to 70,000 customers who requested printed policy terms booklets since October 2021. Whether any data actually leaked is still under investigation, and Taiju Life says it will publish an update if new facts emerge.

title_en: Results of the investigation into money obtained by fraud by a former employee of the company
summary_en: Taiju Life Insurance announced on 14 March 2025 the results of its investigation into a former employee of its Saitama branch (Misato sales office), first disclosed on 17 January 2025. From May 2013 to January 2025 the employee defrauded 20 customers of about 81.3 million yen. The methods were false explanations that led customers to reduce policies or withdraw funds, and bogus investment offers. Taiju Life has repaid the victims and is strengthening payment monitoring, customer warnings and detection of employee irregularities.

title_en: Revision of the single-premium foreign-currency endowment insurance 'Dream Road' – strengthening investment capability through Nippon Life Group synergies
summary_en: Taiju Life announced on 30 July 2025 that it will revise its single-premium foreign-currency endowment product "Dream Road" from 1 August 2025. It will raise the standard for setting the assumed interest rate by changing how assets are managed. For the US dollar version, it will change the portfolio together with Nissay Asset Management. For the Australian dollar version, it will reinsure with Resolution Re Ltd. and use that firm's investment methods. The release notes the rate may not always end up higher than before. It also says the product reaches its 10th anniversary in October 2025.

summary_en: On 29 August 2025, Nippon Life, Taiju Life, Nissay Wealth Life and Hanasaku Life announced that their contracted agency, the Hoken Minaoshi Honpo Group, had published its investigation results on the ransomware attack. The encrypted files held policy-related personal data, including names, addresses, phone numbers, birth dates, email addresses and policy numbers. The investigation found no trace of a leak, external outflow or misuse so far. The insurers apologised and gave customer contact lines.

title_en: Launch of 'Kaede Road' (楓ロード), a yen-denominated single-premium endowment insurance
summary_en: Taiju Life announced on 24 September 2026 that it will launch "Kaede Road" on 21 October 2026. It is a yen-denominated single-premium endowment insurance with no dividends and annual survival benefits. The policy term is 5, 10 or 15 years, and the premium range is ¥2 million to under ¥100 million. The maturity benefit can be taken as a lump sum, an annuity or a switch to whole-life cover. Surrender values are subject to a market value adjustment, so they can fall below the premium paid.
